in_marathi.name: Upavan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Upavan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Upavana' meaning 'forest abode' or 'dwelling in the forest'. In Hindu mythology, forests are considered sacred places of meditation and spiritual growth, where one can connect with nature and the divine.
